definitions.explanation: A single page or screen in a presentation. Used for PowerPoint slides and similar visual aids.
A smooth, gliding movement or the act of sliding something. Also used as a suru-verb meaning to slide or shift.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}のスライドに{進|すす}んでください。
examples.english: Please move to the next slide.

examples.japanese: {発表|はっぴょう}のためにスライドを{30|さんじゅう}{枚|まい}{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: I prepared 30 slides for the presentation.

examples.japanese: ドアをスライドさせる。
{画面|がめん}を{右|みぎ}にスライドする。
examples.english: To slide the screen to the right.

examples.japanese: {予定|よてい}を{来週|らいしゅう}にスライドさせてもいいですか。
examples.english: Would it be okay to push the schedule back to next week?

notes:
USAGE:
The presentation meaning is the most common in business and academic settings. スライドする can also mean to shift or push back a schedule or deadline — a distinctly Japanese extension of the English meaning.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スライドを{作|つく}る: to make slides
- スライドショー: slideshow
- スライド{式|しき}: sliding type
- {予定|よてい}をスライドする: to push back a schedule
